name: Lucius Calvus (Signifer)
notes: Standard bearer and unit banker. Carries the Signum standard. Manages the unit's savings deposits. Lorica Hamata, banker's satchel.
gm_notes: NPC Signifer. Manages financial records for the unit -- soldiers deposit pay with him for safekeeping. Knows who is in debt and who has savings. Neutral, methodical. Will not share financial records without authorization, but a DC 12 Persuasion establishes general debt levels in the unit without specifics.
